label: Telegram completed shift summary
info: See telegram-shift-summary.README.md. Connect a branch AFTER Update Shift Code-wise Production, preserving existing branches. Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and SHIFT_REPORT_ENABLED=true here. Approved Manager accounts only. No AI call.

name: Wait for all lines + deliver report
Safe error + allow later retry
func: const store=env.get('SHIFT_REPORT_CONTEXT_STORE')||undefined; const states=flow.get('telegramShiftReports',store)||{}; if(msg.shiftReport&&states[msg.shiftReport.key]) states[msg.shiftReport.key].busyUntil=Date.now()+30000; flow.set('telegramShiftReports',states,store); return {payload:{ok:false,description:'Shift report failed. Check MongoDB, bot configuration and connectivity. Delivery lease expires after five minutes.'}};
